Theorem
[Lower bound for scalar curvature of GRS (Theorem 27.2)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0024, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0025, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0026, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0027 ↗ def:chow-iv-weighted-operators 1. ch27:27.2\group Scalar curvature bounds

If $(\mathcal M^n,g,f,\varepsilon )$ is complete, then $R\ge 0$ for a shrinker or steady soliton, and $R\ge -n/2$ for an expander.
Proof

\sketch Use a radial cutoff $\Phi _c=\eta (r/c)R$ in the differential inequality for $\Delta _fR$. The cutoff satisfies $\eta ''-2(\eta ')^2/\eta \ge -\mathrm{const}$; the weighted distance comparison estimate controls $\Delta _fr$. The minimum principle gives $R\ge 0$ when $\varepsilon \le 0$ and, with a piecewise linear cutoff, $R\ge -n/2$ when $\varepsilon =1$.

□
